title: Signal: OS command execution via x.execute (groovy) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on the x.execute call in groovy code.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: any x.execute call matches, including fully trusted invocations. Dataflow from untrusted input is not proven — treat every hit as review-required.
fpNotes: Trusted, hardcoded commands (no variables) are the common false positive; confirm no interpolated input before dismissing.
